name: 37220 · Nashville, TN
findings: ZIP 37220 (Nashville) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37220 (Nashville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37220 (Nashville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
